This script is used to perform MultiVI analysis.

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(data.table)

library(Signac)
library(Seurat)
library(GenomeInfoDb)
library(EnsDb.Hsapiens.v75)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(reticulate)
library(sceasy)
library(hdf5r)
library(biovizBase)
set.seed(1234)
```

```{r}
NK_panel <- c(
  "CD57", "CD14", "CD25", "CD8", "CCR7", "PD1", "CD7", "TIM-3", "NKG2D", "TIGIT",
  "NKG2C", "CD27", "NKp30", "CXCR6", "CD45RO", "CD69", "CD49a", "CXCR5", "CD127",
  "KIR2DL1", "NKB1 (KIR3DL1)", "DNAM-1", "NKG2A", "CD3", "CD38", "CD4", "CD56",
  "HLA-DR", "CD16", "IFITM1", "IFIT1", "AIM2", "IFIT3", "SLFN11", "MX2", "pIRF3",
  "MX1", "RIGI", "BRD4", "OAS1"
)

NK_signal = c("PTPRC", "HLA-DMB", "HLA-DMA", "HLA-DPB1", "HLA-G")
CD8_signal = c("SLFN11", "AIM2", "CCR7", "IFITM1", "CD7", "MX1", "TIGIT", "MX2", "CD38", "IFIT3", "CXCR5", "BRD4", "CD14", "CD69", "MAPK14", "HNRNPD", "HNRNPH1", "YBX1", "FOS", "SYNCRIP", "NFATC3", "RARA", "ITK", "NR3C1", "DDX5", "NPM1", "SLA2", "CD4")
```

```{r}
sc <- import("scanpy", convert = FALSE)
scvi <- import("scvi", convert = FALSE)
```


```{r}
data_dir <- "~/Research_2025/Gladstone/Data/"

Data.input = readRDS(paste0(data_dir, "Seurat_RNA_ATAC_CD8_NK.rds"))
```


```{r}
PID.use = c(9, 12)
object.list = list()
output.list = list()

for (i in 1:length(PID.use)) {
  seurat = subset(Data.input, subset = PID == PID.use[i])
  
  
  seurat<-UpdateSeuratObject(seurat)
  
  # converting between Seurat and AnnData
  adata_rna <- convertFormat(seurat, from="seurat", to="anndata", main_layer="data", assay="RNA", drop_single_values=FALSE)
  adata_atac_act <- convertFormat(seurat, from="seurat", to="anndata", main_layer="data", assay="ATAC", drop_single_values=FALSE)
  
  # provide adata_atac_act unknown cell type labels
  adata_atac_act$obs$insert(adata_atac_act$obs$shape[1], "celltype", "Unknown")
  
  ad <- import("anndata")
  
  adata_both <- ad$concat(
    list(adata_rna, adata_atac_act),
    join = "inner",             # old .concatenate() default: intersection of var names
    label = "batch",            # creates the same 'batch' column in .obs
    keys = list("0", "1"),      # old default numbered the datasets 0, 1, 2...
    index_unique = "-"          # old default: append "-0", "-1" to duplicate barcodes
  )
  
  obs_py <- adata_both$obs
  obs_py$reset_index(drop = FALSE, inplace = TRUE)
  obs_r <- reticulate::py_to_r(obs_py$to_dict(orient = "list"))
  obs_r <- as.data.frame(obs_r)
  # head(obs_r)
  
  # assign variable genes
  sc$pp$highly_variable_genes(
    adata_both,
    flavor="seurat_v3",
    n_top_genes=r_to_py(20385), # used all the measured genes
    batch_key="batch",
    subset=TRUE
  )
  scvi$model$SCVI$setup_anndata(adata_both, labels_key="predicted.celltype.l1", batch_key="batch")
  
  # train the modal
  model <- scvi$model$SCVI(adata_both, gene_likelihood="nb", dispersion="gene-batch")
  model$train()
  
  lvae <- scvi$model$SCANVI$from_scvi_model(model, "Unknown", adata=adata_both)
  lvae$train(max_epochs = as.integer(100), n_samples_per_label = as.integer(100))
  
  # identify DE genes
  celltype_1 <- "NK"
  celltype_2 <- "CD8 T"
  
  de_results = lvae$differential_expression(
    adata = adata_both,
    groupby = "predicted.celltype.l1",   # or your cluster/condition column
    group1 = celltype_1,
    group2 = celltype_2
  )
  
  # convert the results to data frame
  de_df <- py_to_r(de_results$reset_index()$to_dict(orient = "list"))
  de_df <- as.data.frame(de_df)
  
  object.list[[i]] = lvae
  
  output.list[[i]] = de_df
}
```


```{r}
saveRDS( output.list, file = "~/Research_2025/Gladstone/MultiVI/output_allgenes_NK_CD8.rds")
saveRDS( object.list, file = "~/Research_2025/Gladstone/MultiVI/object_allgenes_NK_CD8.rds")
```


################################################################################

# RNA-only


```{r}
PID.use = c(9, 12)
object.list = list()
RNA.output.list = list()

for (i in 1:length(PID.use)) {
  seurat = subset(Data.input, subset = PID == PID.use[i])
  
  
  seurat<-UpdateSeuratObject(seurat)
  
  # converting between Seurat and AnnData
  adata <- convertFormat(seurat, from="seurat", to="anndata", main_layer="data", assay="RNA", drop_single_values=FALSE)
  
  ad <- import("anndata")
  
  # run setup_anndata
  scvi$model$SCVI$setup_anndata(adata)
  
  # create the model
  model = scvi$model$SCVI(adata)
  
  # train the model
  model$train()
  
  # to specify the number of epochs when training:
  # model$train(max_epochs = as.integer(400))
  
  # get the latent represenation
  latent = model$get_latent_representation()
  
  # put it back in our original Seurat object
  latent <- as.matrix(latent)
  rownames(latent) = colnames(seurat)
  seurat[["scvi"]] <- CreateDimReducObject(embeddings = latent, key = "scvi_", assay = DefaultAssay(seurat))
  
  celltype_1 <- "NK"
  celltype_2 <- "CD8 T"
  
  DE <- model$differential_expression(adata, 
                                      groupby = "predicted.celltype.l1",   # or your cluster/condition column
                                      group1 = celltype_1,
                                      group2 = celltype_2)
  
  RNA.output.list[[i]] = DE
}
```


```{r}
saveRDS( RNA.output.list, file = "~/Research_2025/Gladstone/MultiVI/RNA_only_allgenes_NK_CD8.rds")
```

## 3 score rank

```{r}
PID = c(9, 12)
df.list = list()
output.list = output_allgenes_NK_CD8_PID_9_12

for (i in 1:2) {
  rna_df = RNA.output.list[[i]]
    rna_df <- py_to_r(rna_df$reset_index()$to_dict(orient = "list"))
  rna_df <- as.data.frame(rna_df)
  
  atac_df = ATAC.output.list[[i]]
      atac_df <- py_to_r(atac_df$reset_index()$to_dict(orient = "list"))
  atac_df <- as.data.frame(atac_df)
  
  combined_df = output.list[[i]]
  
  # NK
  rna_df_nk <- rna_df[order(-rna_df$scale1), ]
  atac_df_nk <- atac_df[order(-atac_df$scale1), ]
  combined_df_nk <- combined_df[order(-combined_df$scale1), ]
  
    # CD8
  rna_df_cd8 <- rna_df[order(-rna_df$scale2), ]
  atac_df_cd8 <- atac_df[order(-atac_df$scale2), ]
  combined_df_cd8 <- combined_df[order(-combined_df$scale2), ]
  
  # function for obtain the rank
  
  rank_by <- function(df, score_col, gene_col = "index") {
    ranked <- df[order(-df[[score_col]]), ]
    ranked$rank <- seq_len(nrow(ranked))
    setNames(ranked$rank, ranked[[gene_col]])[genes_of_interest]
  }
  
  # get the rank for NK signals
  
  genes_of_interest <- c(NK_panel, NK_signal)
  
  comparison <- data.frame(
    gene           = genes_of_interest,
    rank_rna       = rank_by(rna_df_nk, "scale1"),
    rank_atac      = rank_by(atac_df_nk, "scale1"),
    rank_combined  = rank_by(combined_df_nk, "scale1")
  )

  comparison_nk <- comparison[order(comparison$rank_combined), ]
  comparison_nk$cell_type = "NK"
  comparison_nk$PID = PID[i]
  
  # get the rank for CD8 signals
  
  genes_of_interest <- CD8_signal
  
  comparison <- data.frame(
    gene           = genes_of_interest,
    rank_rna       = rank_by(rna_df_cd8, "scale1"),
    rank_atac      = rank_by(atac_df_cd8, "scale1"),
    rank_combined  = rank_by(combined_df_cd8, "scale1")
  )
  
  comparison_cd8 <- comparison[order(comparison$rank_combined), ]
  comparison_cd8$cell_type = "CD8_T"
  comparison_cd8$PID = PID[i]

  df.list[[i]] = rbind(comparison_nk, comparison_cd8)
  
}
```



```{r}
MultiVI_3score_comparison = rbindlist(df.list)

write.csv(MultiVI_3score_comparison, file = "~/Research_2026/STTT_letter/STTT_Letter_Revision/MultiVI_3score_comparison.csv")
```
